name: Defensive Tactic
text:
Use in combat: Cancel one [DAMAGE] result.
You may spend one [PLANETARY] or [MOON] to cancel an additional [DAMAGE] or [CRIT] result.
notes: Only 'Use' is printed bold; 'in combat' is regular weight (unlike the faction cards, where the whole 'Use in combat' is bold). Second result icon is the spiky sun-burst with a dark centre (same glyph as the Minmatar Battle Plan's result, distinct from the crosshair [AIM]); transcribed as [CRIT].

name: Offensive Tactic
text:
Use in combat: Reroll 1 die.
You may spend one [PLANETARY] or [MOON] to reroll any number of dice instead.
notes: Only 'Use' is printed bold; 'in combat' is regular weight (unlike the faction cards, where the whole 'Use in combat' is bold).

name: Guerilla Warfare
text:
Systems you control have +1 strength.
Use when another player attempts to claim a system you control: Spend one [PLANETARY] or [MOON] to add +1 strength to that system.
notes: Passive effect plus a triggered 'Use when another player attempts to claim a system you control'. Name printed 'GUERILLA' (one R).

name: Strategic Reposition
text: Use: Move one of your small ships to an adjacent system. You may spend one [PLANETARY] or [MOON] to move a medium ship instead.

name: Vanguard Ship
text: At the start of combat, choose an orbit. The enemy cannot target supporting ships in that orbit.

name: Coordinated Attack
text: After you move your fleet to a system with an enemy fleet, you may also move your fleets from adjacent systems to that system.

name: Sequential Jump
text: Use: Remove one exhausted fleet token from a system with your fleet.

name: Star Map
text: Use: If you have no mission cards, draw 1 mission card. Otherwise, discard 1 mission card, then draw 1 mission card.

name: Underdog
text: Use: Gain 1 VP if you have fewer VP than any other player.

name: Technological Breakthrough
text:
Gain 1 VP when research on this card is completed.
During upkeep, you may spend 3 [RESEARCH] to turn this card face down and add it to your development area.

name: Invader
text: Gain 1 VP each time you claim a system controlled by another player.

name: Pacifist
text: Use after another player retreats from combat: gain 1 VP.
notes: Triggered 'Use after another player retreats from combat'.

name: Dirty Politics
text: Use: Pay 5 [ISK] to another player and steal 1 VP from them.

name: Fleet Supremacy
text: During upkeep, gain 1 VP if you have at least 1 large ship.

name: Space Warlord
text: Gain +1 VP each time you win any combat.

name: Lobbyist
text: Every time another player gains VP, gain an equal number of [ISK].

name: Intelligence Network
text: Every time another player uses an event card, gain 2 [ISK].

name: Research Spy
text: Use: Discard this card, choose 1 development completed by another player, search your development deck for it, and immediately complete it.

name: Civilian Resistance
text: Any player using a claim action to claim a system you control must pay you 3 [ISK].

name: Spaceship Insurance
text:
When any of your ships are destroyed, for each gain:
Small ship = 2 [ISK]
Medium ship = 4 [ISK]
Large ship = 6 [ISK]

name: Mineral Market
text: Use: Change one basic mineral to another basic mineral.

name: Manufacturing Hub
text: Use: Perform one manufacturing operation.

name: Trade Contracts
text: Use: Perform one trade operation.

name: Asteroid Mining
text: Use: Choose a system you control and gain a mineral from an asteroid belt in it.

name: Extracting Crew
text: Use: Choose a system you control and gain one of its materials.

name: Galactic Trust Fund
text: Use: Gain 2 [ISK].

name: Mass Production
text: When you build a ship, in that build action, additional ships with the same name each cost 2 [ISK] less to build.

name: Medium Hull
text: You can build medium ships.

name: Large Hull
text: You can build large ships.

name: Defensive Systems T1
text: Unlock [D1] abilities of all your ships.

name: Offensive Systems T1
text: Unlock [O1] abilities of all your ships.

name: Utility Systems T1
text: Unlock [U1] abilities of all your ships.

name: Defensive Systems T2
text: Unlock [D2] abilities of all your ships.

name: Offensive Systems T2
text: Unlock [O2] abilities of all your ships.

name: Utility Systems T2
text: Unlock [U2] abilities of all your ships.

name: Warp Drive Efficiency
text: All your ships have +1 SPD.

name: Assembly Line
text: When you perform a build action, gain +2 [BP].

name: Materials Efficiency
text: Your structure build costs are each reduced by 1 [ISK].

name: Upgraded Eng. Complex - Research Lab
text: During upkeep, if you control at least one engineering complex, you may add a new development card to your development area.
notes: The 'add a new development card' wording here is a conditional, recurring upkeep effect (not the standalone one-off sentence printed on Spaceships cards), so it is kept in text and addsDevelopmentCard is false.

name: Upgraded Eng. Complex - Shipyard
text: You may build ships in any systems you control which are adjacent to any other systems you control with engineering complexes.

name: Upgraded Citadel
text:
Your citadels have 2 strength.
Your citadels each add 1 SUP to every orbit.

name: Upgraded Refinery
text: During upkeep, you gain all planetary and moon materials from systems you control with a refinery. Additionally, for each refinery, you may manufacture 1 [COMPONENT] by spending 1 [MOON] + 1 [PLANETARY].

name: Deployable Infrastructure
text: After claiming a system, you may immediately build one structure in it by paying its cost ignoring build points.

name: Upgraded Customs Office
text: During upkeep, your customs offices each give you 3 [ISK] instead of 2 [ISK].
